name: Omacall
author: Luiz Felipe - F360c4
description: SIP softphone for the Omarchy bar: calls in and out, DTMF, contacts and history, over UDP or TLS. G.729, Opus and G.711, several accounts to switch between, and an interface in seven languages.

barWidget.description: SIP phone: call, answer, DTMF, contacts, history. English, Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, French, German, Japanese

schema.label: Show call timer next to the icon
schema.description: While a call is connected, show its duration as mm:ss beside the phone icon in the bar.

schema.label: Open the panel on an incoming call
schema.description: Pop the panel open by itself when a call comes in, so answering is one click away.

schema.label: Language
schema.description: Language of the panel. Auto follows the LANG environment variable and falls back to English.
